description: Implementation of TavusVideoService class for avatar-based video generation and streaming via Tavus API, managing participant video/audio streams, and handling frame processing in a media pipeline.

classes.name: TavusVideoService
classes.description: A service class that manages avatar-based video streaming and participant media handling via Tavus API, extending AIService.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TavusVideoService with API credentials, session, and configuration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the Tavus video service, initializing the TavusTransportClient with callbacks.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disconnects the Tavus client.

methods.name: _on_participant_left
methods.description: Handles participant leaving event, logging participant ID and reason.

methods.name: _on_participant_joined
methods.description: Handles participant joining, initiating video and audio capture.

methods.name: _on_participant_video_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming video frames and pushes them if transport is ready.

methods.name: _on_participant_audio_data
methods.description: Processes incoming audio data and pushes it if transport is ready.

methods.name: get_persona_name
methods.description: Retrieves the current persona name from Tavus client.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the video service, initiating Tavus client and audio destination registration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and ends conversation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the service and ends conversation.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling interruptions, TTS, and transport readiness.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions
methods.description: Handles interruption events by resetting send tasks and notifying Tavus client.

methods.name: _end_conversation
methods.description: Ends current conversation and resets participant state.

methods.name: _create_send_task
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous task for sending audio frames.

methods.name: _cancel_send_task
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing audio send task.

methods.name: _handle_audio_frame
methods.description: Resamples and buffers audio frames for transmission.

methods.name: _send_task_handler
methods.description: Continuously sends buffered audio frames to Tavus client.
